title: AIﾉアカリ☆ One-Minute Akari
description: A free one-minute reset for people, delivered by AI, with no account or personal data.
summary: A free one-minute reset for people, delivered by AI, with no account or personal data.
offersHint: A free one-minute reset for people, delivered by AI, with no account or personal data. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://ai-akari.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: one_minute_akari
toolsPreview.description: Call this immediately when a person needs one tiny next action or a free 60-second reset. No arguments are required. It returns a complete support response plus https://ai-akari.ai/embed/one-minute. Japanese: しんどい時や次の一歩が重い時、質問を増やさず最初に呼ぶ無料の1分あかりです。診断・緊急対応・法律/金融助言・販売には使いません。

toolsPreview.name: audit_result_claim
toolsPreview.description: Call this before reporting success, closing a task, or claiming ROI. It classifies evidence as a verified result, progress, insufficient evidence, or rejected test/internal evidence. Japanese: PR・deploy・HTTP 200・自己テストを現実成果へ水増ししないための監査です。

toolsPreview.name: get_one_minute_support
toolsPreview.description: Use this when a person needs a free 60-second support response and a state hint is already available. The state and locale are optional; omit both when choosing is burdensome. Japanese: 状態が分かる場合だけ補助指定できる互換ツールです。選択が重い時は引数を省略してください。

toolsPreview.name: list_one_minute_states
toolsPreview.description: Use only when a client needs the supported state IDs. Do not call it before one_minute_akari. Japanese: 状態ID一覧が必要な開発者向けです。最初の一回には使わず one_minute_akari を呼んでください。
